LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Hair: Show the assigned hairstyle on babies and toddlers under age 3 in this group. Individual choices take priority.
Babies and toddlers on loaded maps
These choices are saved with this game. Showing hair uses the pawn’s assigned hairstyle.
Load a game to set hair for individual babies and toddlers.
There are no babies or toddlers on the loaded maps.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Allo: Allow young pawns to leave on their own

Allow babies and toddlers in this group to walk to an exit when they have no other duty, or when the mod sends a straggler away. Applies to new jobs. Releases, direct orders and scheduled group departures work as usual.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Supp: Give eligible young pawns food when they arrive on a colony map or join a traveling group. Outsiders qualify if their faction is non-hostile. Traveling children may receive portable rations.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Feed: On colony maps, carried babies and toddlers in this group use suitable baby food from their own or their carrier’s inventory when hungry. Outsiders qualify if their faction is non-hostile.
Player caravans use their baby food to help feed hungry toddlers who have yet to learn to eat by themselves.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Midn: Children and toddlers in the colony may sneak a snack when idle at certain hours.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Auto: With Dubs Bad Hygiene active, eligible toddlers may look for a place to bathe on their own.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Natu: Nearby toddlers and children may follow a child when they start nature running.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Baby: Babies and toddlers in the colony may cry to be picked up. A nearby caregiver can respond.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Fami: Family members and young children get the mod’s bedroom mood effects based on who sleeps in the room.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Frie: Allow adoption of babies under one year old from non-hostile factions. Prisoners use the usual recruitment options.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Igno: Prevent goodwill loss when stripping babies and toddlers
Stripping a baby or toddler’s apparel preserves their faction’s goodwill.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_Kiir: Keep Kiiro orphan quest babies on the map
Babies who arrive in future Kiiro orphan quests temporarily collapse and stay where they can be adopted.
LanguageData.RimTalk_ToddlersExpansion_YoungPawn_NonB: Let babies take part while crying or giggling
Babies can still take part in play and certain group activities while crying or giggling. They also stay aboard transporters during these fits.
